text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending that maximum one-hour parking from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, be authorized on Cavell Avenue, between Carlaw Avenue and Pape Avenue. This is in response to a petition submitted by residents requesting the City to amend the existing parking regulations on Cavell Avenue in order to deter long-term parking during weekdays.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item until its January 8, 2020 meeting.
